name: TP-Link Easy Smart switch
description: Reads a TP-Link Easy Smart switch (TL-SG105E, TL-SG108E, TL-SG1016PE, TL-SG1024DE and relatives) from its web page: the switch as a network node with the state, speed and packet counters of every port. Netlens shows them on the switch's device page and logs an event when a port goes down or comes back. These switches have no SNMP and no MAC address table, so the devices behind a port cannot be listed. Read-only: it only reads two status pages and logs out again.
author: Netlens
supports: TP-Link TL-SG1016PE hardware 3.0, firmware 1.0.0 Build 20210825 (tested on the real switch)
Other Easy Smart models (TL-SG105E, TL-SG108E, TL-SG1024DE...) use the same pages (not tested)

releases.changelog: First release. The switch as a node with the state, speed and packet counters of every port (needs Netlens 0.4.139 or newer for the Switch ports card and link events).
